title: Jordan psionically calls in an 'egg' object that Fred Baker films
summary: Skywatcher tells of Jordan psionically calls in an 'egg' object that Fred Baker films, about August (year not stated, c. 2024) at Skywatcher event site, patio and backyard, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Skywatcher event site, patio and backyard

tellings.quote: One example: in August one of our main psi-actives, Jordan, probably caused object, and it could to be an "egg". I don't know What is this?

plain: Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to summon UFOs, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that one August, probably in 2024, a team member named Jordan used the power of his mind to call in an object at one of their event sites, on a patio and backyard. According to the team, the object may have been egg-shaped, and a man named Fred Baker filmed it, though the speaker admits not knowing what it was. If true, it would mean people can bring such objects in with their minds alone.
